> USWDS AI Components — Plain-text agent protocol
> Free to browse and download. Components are part of USWDS 3.13.0, in the public domain.
> Home: https://github.com/ednark/uswds-ai-components
> Base layer: https://github.com/ednark/ai-component-registry-spec (submodule at _base/)

---

## Overview

USWDS AI Components is a component registry for AI coding agents building government websites with the U.S. Web Design System (USWDS 3.13.0). The registry contains 146 accessible, mobile-friendly components, each with rich adaptation metadata. It extends the ai-component-registry-spec base layer.

## Machine manifest

> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/uswds-ai-components/main/agents.json

## Sitemap

> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/uswds-ai-components/main/sitemap.xml

---

## Quick start

1. Filter vocab (tiny): GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/uswds-ai-components/main/infinite/facets.json
2. Discovery index (lean): GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/uswds-ai-components/main/infinite/components.index.json
3. Component source: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/uswds-ai-components/main/infinite/{file}
4. Recipes (multi-component patterns): GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/uswds-ai-components/main/infinite/recipes/index.json
   Ordered, nestable component sets for common patterns (contact-form, login-flow,
   data-table-with-sorting, error-handling-stack, navigation-hierarchy). When the task
   matches a recipe, fetch it first — one atomic fetch replaces N component lookups
   plus assembly guesswork.
5. Version history: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/uswds-ai-components/main/infinite/versions.json
   Registry-level history: what changed between registry versions (breakingChanges,
   addedFacets, migrationPath). Check after any gap between your fetches.

---

## Facets

- uswdsComponentType — accordion, alert, banner, breadcrumb, button, card, checkbox, combo-box, etc.
- section — forms (16), navigation (10), feedback (8), data-display (6), layout (4), utilities (3)
- variant — component variant (e.g., bordered, multiselectable for accordion)
- interaction — passive, click, hover, keyboard, focus, drag, pointer
- requiresJs — no, optional, required
- govCompliance — Section 508, WCAG 2.1 AA, 21st Century IDEA, NIST Guidelines
- a11y — wcag21AA, keyboardNav, screenReader, reducedMotion, forcedColors, ariaAttributes
- costTier — cheap, moderate, expensive (composition cost: fetch size + JS behavior)
- prerequisites — components that must be fetched/placed first (e.g., form before inputs)
- compositionRecipes — recipes this component participates in
- fedRampLevel — conservative suitability floor (IL2/IL2+/IL4/IL5); all tiles currently assert IL2+ pending compliance review
- piiHandling — accepts_input (35), displays_only (95), none (16); nistControls and auditTrailCompatible in tile metadata
- touchTargetSize — guaranteed mobile touch target (44px across all tiles)
- supportedTokenProfiles — token profiles supported (highContrast on all tiles; darkMode/compactDensity defined in registry config, not yet asserted)

---

## Decision strategy

When selecting a component for a government UI task:

1. Filter by section (forms, navigation, feedback, data-display, layout, utilities)
2. Check requiresJs — prefer "no" unless task explicitly needs JS behavior
3. Verify govCompliance includes applicable requirements
4. Prefer components with wcag21AA: true and keyboardNav: true
5. Check relatedComponents for commonly paired components
6. Only generate custom UI if no suitable component exists

---

## Filtering example

components
  .filter(c => c.section === 'forms')
  .filter(c => c.requiresJs === 'no')
  .filter(c => c.a11y.wcag21AA === true)

---

## Component schema

Each component record in the index contains:

- id — unique identifier
- file — fetch URL path
- uswdsComponentType — official USWDS component name
- uswdsClass — primary CSS class
- title — component name + variant
- description — one-line summary
- section — forms | navigation | feedback | data-display | layout | utilities
- variant — primary variant name
- variants — all available variant class names
- requiresJs — no | optional | required
- interaction — array of interaction types
- a11y — accessibility features object
- govCompliance — applicable government compliance requirements
- relatedComponents — commonly paired components
- costTier — cheap | moderate | expensive (composition cost)
- prerequisites / incompatibleWith — coordination summaries (component names)
- compositionRecipes — recipes this component participates in
- fedRampLevel / piiHandling / auditTrailCompatible / nistControls — compliance summaries
- touchTargetSize — guaranteed mobile touch target
- supportedTokenProfiles — token profiles supported

The index carries discovery facets and lean summaries ONLY. Adaptation prose
(useWhen, avoidWhen, agentPrompt, editable/preserve areas, limitations,
classMapping, settings, tokenOverrides) is embedded in each tile's
<script id="uswds-agent-meta"> block — fetch the tile for it.

---

## Government compliance

All 146 USWDS component tiles pass WCAG 2.1 AA and support Section 508 accessibility requirements.

Components support:
- Section 508 (36 CFR 1194)
- WCAG 2.1 AA
- 21st Century Integrated Digital Experience Act
- NIST Guidelines

## USWDS Components by Section

### Forms (16)
text-input, checkbox, radio-buttons, select, combo-box, date-picker, date-range-picker, file-input, memorable-date, time-picker, range-slider, character-count, input-mask, input-prefix-suffix, form, validation

### Navigation (10)
header, side-navigation, breadcrumb, pagination, step-indicator, in-page-navigation, search, language-selector, icon-list, link

### Feedback (8)
alert, site-alert, modal, tooltip, banner, process-list, summary-box, tag

### Data Display (6)
table, card, collection, identifier, icon, data-visualizations

### Layout (4)
footer, header, prose, typography

### Utilities (3)
button, button-group, accordion

---

## Adaptation metadata fields

Each tile includes:

- useWhen — situations this component fits well
- avoidWhen — situations to avoid this component
- agentPrompt — example adaptation instruction with actual class names
- editableAreas — CSS classes, tokens, attributes safe to change
- preserveElements — markup patterns and ARIA that must be kept
- knownLimitations — caveats and constraints
- tokenOverrides — USWDS design tokens commonly overridden
- relatedComponents — USWDS components often used together
- coordination — prerequisites, incompatibleWith, compositionCost, agentPromptSequence, compositionRecipes, variantRules
- compliance — nistControls, fedRampLevel, section508, wcag21AA, piiHandling, auditTrailCompatible, dataMaskingCompatible
- mobileUX — touchTargetSize, requiredMinSpacing, orientationLocked, fullscreenSafe
- supportedTokenProfiles — token profiles this component supports (see registry.config.json tokenProfiles)

## Patterns

When building common government UI patterns, check recipes first
(recipes/index.json — they include fetch order, nesting, validation, and a11y notes):

| Pattern | Components to retrieve |
|---|---|
| Contact form (recipe) | form + text-input + select + character-count + button + validation |
| Login flow (recipe) | form + text-input + button + link + alert |
| Error handling stack (recipe) | validation/alert + alert/error + summary-box/error + text-input/error |
| Navigation hierarchy (recipe) | skip-nav + banner + header + breadcrumb + side-navigation + footer + identifier |
| Data table (recipe) | table + pagination + summary-box |
| Multi-step form | step-indicator + form + text-input + validation |
| Alert-heavy page | alert + site-alert + summary-box |
| Data display | table + card + data-visualizations + collection |
| Search interface | header + search + pagination + breadcrumb |

---


## Quality gates and declared gaps

Do not retrieve or deploy a component that:

- Has `costTier: "expensive"` unless the task explicitly requires the richer behavior — avoid for mobile-primary or static contexts
- Has `requiresJs: "required"` when the delivery context has no JavaScript
- Whose `constraints.knownLimitations` block the delivery context
- Implements a concept declared in `gaps` (registry.config.json) — use the gap's nearestAlternative instead; never invent a component-style class for it
- Needs layout or typography classes outside the tiles — use `core-classes.json` (the documented untiled layer), never invented component classes

Registry mandates that act as gates:

- Prefer `requiresJs: "no"` and `costTier: "cheap"` unless the task requires otherwise
- Check `govCompliance` (Section 508 / WCAG 2.1 AA / 21st Century IDEA) for government deployments
- Pair headers with skip-nav; render language toggles as plain links (no official USWDS language component)

Declared gaps: see `gaps` in registry.config.json. Untiled layout/typography layer: see `infinite/core-classes.json`.

---

## Output contract

When returning components to a user, include:

1. Reason: why this component was selected over alternatives
2. Selected components: file paths and titles
3. USWDS classes needed: the exact class names to apply
4. Token overrides: the design tokens to customize
5. Remaining work: what the component does not yet cover
6. Related components: what to retrieve or build next
